## Service Areas

Kyara Eyre serves five luxury real estate markets in metro Phoenix, Arizona:

- **Paradise Valley**: guard-gated estates, $2M – $20M+, between Camelback Mountain and Mummy Mountain. Guide: https://kyaraeyre.com/areas/paradise-valley.html
- **North Scottsdale**: golf and hiking communities including DC Ranch, Grayhawk, Silverleaf, Desert Mountain, Troon North, and Estancia, $1M – $30M+. Guide: https://kyaraeyre.com/areas/north-scottsdale.html
- **Central Scottsdale**: Old Town walkability, McCormick Ranch, Gainey Ranch, and the Cactus Corridor, $500K – $4M+. Guide: https://kyaraeyre.com/areas/central-scottsdale.html
- **Arcadia**: citrus-grove lots and ranch-home renovations near Camelback Mountain, $529K – $5M+. Guide: https://kyaraeyre.com/areas/arcadia.html
- **North Phoenix**: newer master-planned communities including Desert Ridge, Sonoran Foothills, Tatum Ranch, and Union Hills, $400K – $1.5M+. Guide: https://kyaraeyre.com/areas/north-phoenix.html
